seo.title: Seattle Homeless Help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified practical resources for people experiencing homelessness in Seattle.

page.heading: SEATTLE - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger: 911. Shelter referrals: 211. Families needing same-day shelter: 206-245-1026. Crisis support: call or text 988.
page.notice: Availability, eligibility, hours, and capacity can change. Call ahead when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, job, or legal representation.
page.intro: Call 211 for current shelter options. Families with children can call 206-245-1026 from 9:00 AM; space is not guaranteed.
page.footer: Information can change. Call ahead when possible and report incorrect information through the GitHub link in the footer.

entries.title: Emergency services — 911
entries.description: For immediate danger, fire, a life-threatening medical emergency, or violence.
entries.how_to_access: Give the exact location and explain what is happening.

entries.title: Washington 2-1-1
entries.description: Free referrals for shelter, food, health, benefits, and other resources.

entries.title: Family Emergency Shelter Access Line
entries.description: Same-day family shelter access for households with children; placement depends on space.

entries.title: King County Coordinated Entry
entries.description: Assessment and connection to housing resources; not a same-day shelter guarantee.
entries.how_to_access: Contact the access point for your household.

entries.title: Salvation Army William Booth Center
entries.description: Shelter serving adult men, including veterans. Eligibility and availability change.
entries.how_to_access: Call 211 or the center before traveling.

entries.title: Compass Center — food and basic services
entries.description: Day-center food and basic services for adults experiencing homelessness; availability varies.
entries.how_to_access: Check current hours and arrive early.

entries.title: Compass Center — hygiene
entries.description: Showers, laundry, restrooms, and hygiene support may be available.

entries.title: King County homeless health services
entries.description: Clinics and outreach for people experiencing homelessness; locations and schedules vary.
entries.how_to_access: Find a current clinic and confirm hours.

entries.title: Compass Center
entries.description: Day center with restrooms, hygiene, mail, banking, and navigation.

entries.title: Washington Connection
entries.description: Apply for food, medical, cash, and other public benefits.
entries.how_to_access: Apply online; approval depends on eligibility.

entries.title: WorkSource Seattle-King County
entries.description: Free job search, workshops, training information, and employer connections.
entries.how_to_access: Find a center and confirm hours.

entries.title: Northwest Justice Project — CLEAR
entries.description: Free civil legal help for eligible low-income Washington residents.

entries.title: King County Domestic Violence Hopeline
entries.description: Confidential support, safety planning, and referrals.
entries.how_to_access: Call or chat when safe; call 911 for immediate danger.

entries.title: National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
entries.description: Connects veterans who are homeless or at risk with VA services and local resources.
entries.how_to_access: Call and say you are a veteran who is homeless or at risk of losing housing.

entries.title: Seattle Humane Pet Food Bank
entries.description: Pet food help for eligible community members; enrollment and supply rules apply.
